item.title: El-Sayed's half sister, a professor, arrested for allegedly assaulting officer at anti-ICE protest
item.description: Eman Abdelhadi, half sister of Abdul El-Sayed, faces a felony charge for allegedly spitting on a trooper during an anti-ICE protest in Broadview.

item.title: Bessent announces unprecedented economic measures against Iran
Who controls the Strait of Hormuz now? Ship traffic data offers clues
item.description: Ship traffic through the Strait of Hormuz has dropped significantly compared to pre-war levels earlier this year, according to recent data.

item.title: MN Senate candidate criticized for blaming Walz for fraud despite being his deputy
item.description: Lt. Gov. Peggy Flanagan deflected responsibility for the fraud scandal, drawing criticism for pointing to Tim Walz instead.
